2607.21210.title: Explainable Belief Harmonization under Dynamic Epistemic Partitions
2607.21210.paper_summary: Existing approaches to multi-agent belief combination have established mature foundations for combining uncertain beliefs under common assumptions: consensus methods use iterative averaging, logic-based methods resolve conflicting knowledge bases, and epistemic logic analyzes agents' information states. Typically, these approaches assume that the structure determining what each agent can represent remains fixed. However, in many scenarios, agents gain or lose observational capacity during execution, and what was once admissible may become structurally impossible. This paper presents a formal framework for handling such runtime changes in epistemic partitions over continuous belief profiles. A hybrid approach exploits the advantages of answer set programming in elaboration tolerance, declarative integrity constraints, and explanations, with the numerical flexibility of Python. The framework applies to domains where agents operate at heterogeneous and possibly changing levels of resolution, and provides formal guarantees of admissibility preservation under refinement, unique mass-preserving repair under coarsening, and explanation completeness. Evaluation across 100 randomly generated topology changes confirms complete violation detection and explanation coverage.
2607.21210.paper_summary_zh: 現有的多代理信念結合方法已建立成熟的基礎，以在共同假設下結合不確定的信念：共識方法使用迭代平均，基於邏輯的方法解決衝突的知識庫，而認識論邏輯分析代理的資訊狀態。通常，這些方法假設決定每個代理可以表示的結構保持不變。然而，在許多情境中，代理在執行過程中獲得或失去觀察能力，而曾經可接受的內容可能變得結構上不可能。本文提出了一個正式框架，用於處理在連續信念配置上進行的此類運行時變更。混合方法利用答案集編程在擴展容忍性、聲明性完整性約束和解釋方面的優勢，結合Python的數值靈活性。該框架適用於代理在異質且可能變化的解析度水平上運作的領域，並提供在細化下保留可接受性的正式保證、在粗化下的唯一質量保留修復以及解釋的完整性。對100個隨機生成的拓撲變更的評估確認了完全違規檢測和解釋覆蓋。
2607.21210.author: Adam Kostka et.al.
